title: CNH to announce 2026 Q1 results on April 30
summary: CNH to announce 2026 Q1 results on April 30 Basildon, April 16, 2026 CNH (NYSE: CNH) will release its financial results for the First Quarter of 2026 on Thursday, April 30, 2026. A live listen-only webcast of the financial results conference call will begin at 9:30 a.m. ET on the same day here: bit.ly/CNH_Q1_2026 For those unable to participate in the live session, a replay will remain archived in the Investor Relations section of the corporate website ( www.cnh.com ) for 12 months. Dial-in details: Those interested in participating in the QA session should connect via telephone at least 10 minutes prior to the start of the event.
